title: This Is the Day!
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about going looking for the good on a morning with nothing planned, and Scout the Seeker is the Traveler who finds something wonderful in every new day.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout finds something wonderful in every new day. In Scout’s world today: it was a plain, rainy morning with no big plans. But Scout said, “I wonder what good things today will bring?” and went looking — and found a puddle to splash, a rainbow after lunch, and a cozy story with Grandma. Just like the song-writer who was glad for the day Heavenly Father made, Scout discovered that every day holds a gift when we look for it.
